bootstrapPending.activeInviteHelp.en: A bootstrap invite is already active. Check your Paperclip CN startup logs for the first-admin URL, or run this command on the host to rotate it:
bootstrapPending.activeInviteHelp.zh-CN: 已有一个初始化邀请处于激活状态。请查看 Paperclip CN 启动日志中的首个管理员 URL，或在宿主机运行此命令进行轮换：

bootstrapPending.claimBody.en: No admin has claimed this instance yet. Claim it now to become the first admin and start onboarding.
bootstrapPending.claimBody.zh-CN: 还没有管理员领取此实例。立即领取，成为首个管理员并开始引导流程。

bootstrapPending.claimedBody.en: Refresh to sign in, or ask the existing admin to invite you from Instance settings -> Access.
bootstrapPending.claimedBody.zh-CN: 刷新后登录，或请现有管理员从“实例设置 -> 访问”邀请你。

bootstrapPending.claimedTitle.en: Someone else has already claimed this instance.
bootstrapPending.claimedTitle.zh-CN: 已有其他人领取了此实例。

bootstrapPending.commandHelp.en: Run this command on the host that runs Paperclip CN to print a one-time first-admin invite URL:
bootstrapPending.commandHelp.zh-CN: 在运行 Paperclip CN 的宿主机上执行此命令，打印一次性的首个管理员邀请 URL：

bootstrapPending.finishFromHost.en: Prefer to finish setup from the host?

bootstrapPending.finishTitle.en: Finish setting up this Paperclip CN
bootstrapPending.finishTitle.zh-CN: 完成此 Paperclip CN 的设置

bootstrapPending.inviteOnlyBody.en: This instance runs in invite-only mode. The operator must generate a one-time first-admin invite URL from the host. Once you have the link, open it from this browser to finish setup.
bootstrapPending.inviteOnlyBody.zh-CN: 此实例运行在仅邀请模式。操作者必须在宿主机生成一次性的首个管理员邀请 URL。拿到链接后，请在此浏览器中打开以完成设置。

bootstrapPending.publicModeDisabled.en: Browser-based claim is intentionally disabled in public mode so anyone on the network can't promote themselves.
bootstrapPending.publicModeDisabled.zh-CN: 公开模式下有意禁用浏览器领取，避免网络上的任何人自行提升权限。

bootstrapPending.serverUnreachable.en: We couldn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
bootstrapPending.serverUnreachable.zh-CN: 无法连接服务器，请稍后重试。

bootstrapPending.sessionExpired.en: Your session expired. Sign in again to claim this instance.
bootstrapPending.sessionExpired.zh-CN: 你的会话已过期。请重新登录后领取此实例。

bootstrapPending.setupComplete.en: Setup is complete. Taking you to onboarding to create your first company...
bootstrapPending.setupComplete.zh-CN: 设置已完成。正在前往引导流程创建你的第一家公司...

bootstrapPending.signInBody.en: No admin has claimed this instance yet. Sign in or create your Paperclip CN account to become the first admin from this browser.
bootstrapPending.signInBody.zh-CN: 还没有管理员领取此实例。请登录或创建 Paperclip CN 账号，从此浏览器成为首个管理员。

bootstrapPending.waitingTitle.en: This Paperclip CN is waiting on its first admin
bootstrapPending.waitingTitle.zh-CN: 此 Paperclip CN 正在等待首个管理员
